sample_unit: clinical event-temporal expression pairs in annotated French clinical narratives
models_evaluated: open-weight on-premises LLMs (four, unnamed in abstract)
unlisted_practices: Prompt-chaining strategy to sequentially normalize extracted temporal expressions in clinical text
Zero- and few-shot prompting of open-weight on-premises LLMs to reduce annotation burden for temporal relation extraction
Using LLM-as-a-judge alongside exact-match metrics and human validation to evaluate extraction

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a prompt-chaining approach with open-weight LLMs for temporal relation extraction and normalization from clinical text without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard.
